fieldNotes.truckGate: The plant is fully ringed by chain-link perimeter fencing (some with green privacy slats), confirmed in Street View (2026-04) on multiple road frontages. The SW-corner driveway off Pegasus Drive is a wide controlled access point: a fenced pinch-point with on-post signage where the property driveway meets the public road. Marked true on the fenced controlled-entry evidence; the exact barrier-arm hardware is screened by mature trees and not fully verifiable — flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed guard booth could be positively confirmed from Street View. A small blue-roof structure sits near the SW entrance in z20 satellite that may be a gatehouse, but it could not be confirmed as a staffed multi-window booth — marked false, flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: Set true on the basis that there is a controlled fenced gate but no confirmed staffed booth (implying kiosk / call-box / app check-in). Flagged uncertain alongside guardShack.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Broad internal paved aprons and access roads inside the fence line give ample queue room before the dock banks.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Long internal approach from the SW entrance to the dock banks — well over 3 trucks of stacking room.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide gate apron at the SW driveway with ample unused paved width to add a dedicated express/bypass lane.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: The large east warehouse building has a continuous dock face with 30+ trailers backed in along its east side (visible z19); the manufacturing buildings have additional dock faces on the west/rail side. Total estimated 50+ doors. Low-confidence overhead count.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Trailer drop/parking lots around the east warehouse and along the rail side hold an estimated 25-50 parked trailers; honest overhead estimate.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Distinct dock banks on different building faces (east warehouse dock bank vs. west/rail-side plant docks) imply physically separate ship/receive flows; functional split not verifiable from imagery.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: True — a multi-building manufacturing campus: a large warehouse building plus several connected manufacturing buildings on the same fenced property.
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale identified in the imagery.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Dedicated trailer-storage lots full of parked trailers are present alongside active dock staging.
fieldNotes.railServed: A rail line/spur runs N-S along the west edge of the plant with rail cars parked directly against the plant building (visible z19) — the plant is rail-served.
fieldNotes.truckGateCount: At least one main controlled entrance at the SW corner; a second access driveway exists on the south frontage. Estimated 2; flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: The plant sits within Temple TX's developed industrial fabric, immediately beside an I-35-area highway interchange with continuous surrounding industrial development. Urban setting.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: Derived from the perimeter box (~95 acres) — a large multi-building plant property.
